secrets.name: WORKOS_API_KEY
secrets.description: WorkOS API key from your WorkOS dashboard → API Keys page

secrets.name: WORKOS_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: WorkOS Client ID from your WorkOS dashboard → API Keys page

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_...) from your Stripe dashboard → Developers → API keys

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) from Stripe dashboard -> Developers -> Webhooks -> your /api/webhooks/stripe endpoint -> Signing secret. Without it the webhook route fails closed and no payment events are processed.
